title: (fix) Attach visit to visit note submissions
body:

## Summary

This attaches the active visit uuid to the saved visit note payload in `VisitNotesForm` (`visit: activeVisit?.uuid ?? null`), guarding against a null active visit. This fixes the issue of visit notes not being attached to the active visit.

## Other
Removes the dead `testsFilter` `useMemo` (and the now-orphaned `ExternalOverviewProps` import) from `VisitSummary`. The encounter-based filtering it represented now lives inside the `TestsSummary` component, which builds the filter itself from its `encounters` prop — so the parent's copy was unused.
